what: Cross-check of the humanoid fixes with two REAL Mixamo exports, run by hand after tools/synty/humanoid_dryrun.sh (same code as the commit that adds this file).

files.kind: Mixamo FBX WITH skin, centimetres, mixamorig: bones, takes 'Take 001' (empty, 1 key) + 'mixamo.com' (18.2 s)
Mixamo character as glTF (mixamorig bones, arms ~13 deg below horizontal at rest), textured

licence: Mixamo (Adobe) content redistributed by the three.js examples; NOT CC0. Used only locally as test data in /tmp and assets/quarantine + assets/imported (gitignored), deleted after the run. Never committed; no screenshot of them is committed.
setup: Synty-style A-pose SK_Chr_Knight_01.fbx -> unit.B03; Samba FBX -> enemy.E04 (character) AND the humanoid 'victory' clip; Soldier.glb -> enemy.E06; other clips = generated Mixamo-named FBX without skin.

results.build: all wrappers OK, facing -Z, no warnings; Samba E04 1.65x1.54x0.32 m (cm -> m handled by the importer), Soldier E06 2.94x3.41x0.90 m (T-pose arm span after Fix Silhouette)
results.bug_found: AnimationLibraryBuilder.take_clip took the first clip = the empty 'Take 001' (0.96 s, 1 key per track): victory showed the rest pose. Fixed: the longest clip that moves wins, 'mixamo' in the name preferred -> 'mixamo.com', 18.2 s, retargeted.
results.bug_found_2: Soldier's rest arms are 13 deg below horizontal, under Godot's Fix Silhouette threshold (15 deg), so its rest was not straightened and every clip came out ~11 deg lower than on the other rigs (idle LeftUpperArm (-0.19,-0.98) vs (-0.41,-0.91)). Fixed: threshold 5 deg -> identical.
results.note: Directions sampled at 45 % of each clip in the wrapper's space (facing -Z). The real Mixamo dance plays on the Synty-named A-pose rig with the same bone directions as on the Mixamo rigs it was made for.
